title: DHFWS Purulia Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 03 Staff Nurse and Pharmacist Posts
description: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti Purulia (DH&FWS Purulia) has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 03 Staff Nurse and Pharmacist positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc. Nursing, GNM, D.Pharm, B.Pharm, or M.Pharm can take advantage of this opportunity and apply for the DHFWS Purulia Notification 2026 .
